_note: Every reader-visible string. crates/core/src/page.rs lists the keys the game reads (REQUIRED); GLOSSARY.md and TONE.md govern the words.
title: Chumontillado
no_webgl: This browser cannot draw the game: it needs WebGL 2.
tagline: A shooter in the cellars. Four players, one life a round. For now, the practice room: learn to move and to shoot, alone or online with friends.
menu_text: The practice room has a slope, two surf ramps, a shaft to climb, straw targets and a bot that hops round the floor. In a duel, the bot shoots back. Play against bots for a match of rounds on the three maps, or host one online for up to three friends.
control_move: Move, and steer in the air. Faster than a run, W alone turns you toward your view; A or D with the mouse turning the same way adds speed.
control_jump: Jump. Hold it to hop again on every landing.
control_crouch: Crouch. At a run, a slide; jump out of it for more speed. In the air, a slam.
control_wall: A wall jump. The count left shows on screen and fills again on the ground.
hint_play: Esc pauses and lists the controls. 1 to 0 take a gun, E a melee weapon.
control_fire: Fire, or swing a melee weapon. The Pincel charges while held and fires when let go. A katana swing parries.
control_guns: Take a gun: 1 to 5 are hitscan, 6 to 0 fire projectiles. Q takes the last one again.
control_melee: Take a melee weapon; again for the next of the three.
control_alt: The katana's lunge. The guadaña's hook: hold it to be pulled to the wall.
host_text: Send friends the invite link, or read them the code. Switch a bot on or off for each free seat, then start.
join_text: Type the room code the host gave you, or paste the whole invite link.
joining_text: Looking for room {code}. This usually takes a few seconds. ({n} s)
online.lobby: You have a seat. The match begins when the host starts it.
online.reload: Another browser in the room runs a different version of the game. Reload the page, and ask the others to reload too.
online.garbled: A message from another browser made no sense, so the match stopped.
online.host_left: The host left, so the match has ended.
online.full: That room is full, or its match has already begun.
online.desync: The browsers' copies of the match came apart, so it stopped.
online.timeout: Nothing has come from the host for ten seconds, so the match has ended. Their connection may have dropped.
online.no_bundle: The code for online play could not load. Reload the page and try again.
online.no_relay: No relay answered, so the room could not open. Check that you are online; a firewall, an ad blocker or a VPN can block the relays. Then try again.
online.no_path: Your browser found the room but could not reach the host. One of you may be on a network that blocks direct links (some offices, schools and VPNs). Try again, or try another network.
online.bad_room: A room code is five letters, without I or O.
online.not_host: Only the host starts the match.
shooting: Your shooting, by how fast you were going
band_trick: Just after a wall jump or slide (½ s)
time_fast: Time at run speed or more
online.still_looking: Still no answer from room {code} after {n} s. Check the code with the host, and that their lobby is still open. If either of you is on a strict network (some offices, schools and VPNs), the browsers may not be able to reach each other: try again, or try another network.
online.knocking: Someone has reached the room but cannot finish joining. Their network may block direct links: ask them to try again, or to try another network.
online.dropped: {who} left the match; a bot plays their seat.
